description: A React component named DetailsViewer that renders detailed information about an object or array, with features like collapsible sections, formatted fields, copy-to-clipboard, and raw JSON view. It is designed for displaying structured data in a user-friendly way within a web application.

classes.name: DetailsViewer
classes.description: A React functional component for displaying detailed structured data with collapsible sections, formatting, and interaction features.

methods.name: safePretty
methods.description: Converts a payload to a pretty-printed JSON string with fallback options.

methods.name: toLabel
methods.description: Formats a key into a user-friendly label using formatLabel utility.

methods.name: isTimestampLike
methods.description: Checks if a key resembles a timestamp field.

methods.name: isTokenLike
methods.description: Checks if a key resembles a token count field.

methods.name: isDurationLike
methods.description: Checks if a key resembles a duration or latency field.

methods.name: formatDuration
methods.description: Formats a numeric value as a duration string, handling seconds and milliseconds.

methods.name: isCurrencyKeyLoose
methods.description: Determines if a key name suggests a currency or cost-related value.

methods.name: formatValueByKey
methods.description: Formats a value based on its key, applying special formatting for currency, tokens, timestamps, durations, or numbers.

methods.name: initialCollapsed
methods.description: Decides if a section should be collapsed based on its depth and collapsedDepth prop.

methods.name: Collapser
methods.description: A subcomponent that renders a collapsible section with toggle button.

methods.name: renderPrimitiveVal
methods.description: Renders a primitive value with appropriate styling and formatting.

methods.name: extractAgentIdentity
methods.description: Extracts agent ID and name from an object, used for rendering agent-related data.

methods.name: renderNode
methods.description: Recursively renders a node (object, array, or primitive) with collapsible sections and special handling for agents.

methods.name: renderEntries
methods.description: Renders key-value entries of an object, with highlighted keys first and collapsible sections.
